purpose: Shebang stdio entrypoint for the MCP server; calls startStdioServer() and exits 1 on failure.
Stdio MCP server (v0.48): registry-driven; tools/list and tools/call iterate tools.js; version read from package.json.
notes: v0.43: two new tools added — search_citations (wraps /api/citations, dir=cited-by|refs) and resolve_ids (wraps /api/ids, DOI↔PMID↔PMCID). Structural scan will pick up code; this note records the curated intent.

purpose: httpExecutor (v0.48): one HTTPS executor returning { status, headers, body|text } for every response; never throws on non-2xx so 402/401/429 bodies reach the agent. TLS-only; key never logged.
notes: v0.43: extended with client functions for /api/citations and /api/ids (searchCitations, resolveIds). Structural scan will pick up the new exports.

purpose: Contract bridge (v0.48): three tool names, agent-facing param subsets and the arg-to-REST mappings (query/body) for search_papers, get_paper, verify_citations.
Pure schema generators from the contract SSOT (v0.48): JSON Schema helpers for tool inputs + openApiSpec() over every ENDPOINT. SDK-free.
Prisma schema: User, Account, Session, VerificationToken, search_history, library_items, ApiKey, ApiUsage, ProcessedEvent, relevance_labels — all models for auth, billing, history, and gold-set.
P3005-safe migration runner: tries prisma migrate deploy; falls back to direct SQL apply + baseline; always exits 0 to never block deploys.
Root package: defines build chain (migrate.mjs → tailwindcss → vite build), postinstall prisma generate, and all runtime/dev deps.
Minimal Vite config: React plugin only. No aliases, chunks, proxy, or SSR.
Tailwind config: standard content scan over index.html + src/**. No custom plugins or theme extensions.
Vercel deploy config: /api/auth/* → handler rewrite, SPA fallback for all non-API paths. Serverless functions auto-detected from api/*.js.
Admin debug probe: drives /api/search with admin key + debug=1; prints origin-revealing envelope (per-adapter table, dedup trace, coverage, ranked results with source). --assert-admin CI mode.
Origin-blind regression guardrail: sends debug=1 with a non-admin key; asserts meta.debug absent and no result.source field. Exit 0=PASS, 1=FAIL.
Public endpoint stress/quality probe (no auth); outputs compact JSON per query for relevance QA. Infers origin heuristically from public fields.
In-process smoke test for ?simple=1 diagnostic mode (v0.36): imports api/search.js handler directly with mock req/res; asserts T1.3 invariants (simpleMode, source visible, no score).
GENERATED vendored copy of api/_shared/apiContract.js so the published opencite-mcp tarball is self-contained. Regenerated by mcp/scripts/sync-contract.mjs on prepublishOnly; never hand-edited.
notes: Source of truth stays api/_shared/apiContract.js (SSOT); this file is a build artifact committed so npx-from-git also works.

purpose: Tool registry SSOT (v0.48): verify_citations, search_papers, get_paper with when-to-call descriptions, generated input schemas, REST mappings, MCP annotations; toToolResult shapes every HTTP response into an MCP result (payload + billing/trust trailer, or an actionable error). SDK-free so api/ can import it for the remote MCP.
